definitions.explanation: Luggage that passengers hand over to an airline or transportation service to be stored in the cargo hold rather than carried on board.

examples.japanese: {預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}は2{個|こ}までです。
examples.english: You can have up to two pieces of checked baggage.

examples.japanese: {預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}を{受|う}け{取|と}る。
{預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}の{重量制限|じゅうりょうせいげん}は23キロです。
examples.english: The weight limit for checked baggage is 23 kilograms.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{預|あず}ける (to deposit, entrust) + {荷物|にもつ} (luggage)

AIRPORT VOCABULARY:
At Japanese airports, you'll encounter:
- {預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}カウンター: baggage check-in counter
- {預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}{受取所|うけとりじょ}: baggage claim area
- {超過手荷物料金|ちょうかてにもつりょうきん}: excess baggage fee

CONTRAST:
- {預|あず}け{荷物|にもつ}: checked baggage (stored in cargo)
- {機内持|きないも}ち{込|こ}み: carry-on (brought into cabin)

RELATED TERMS:
- {手荷物|てにもつ}: hand luggage
- {荷物|にもつ}: luggage, baggage
- {受託手荷物|じゅたくてにもつ}: checked baggage (formal)
